command: set -u; echo '=== ID ==='; hostname; whoami; date -Is; echo '=== COMMANDS ==='; command -v crush || true; type -a crush 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== PROCESSES ==='; ps -eo pid,lstart,args | grep -Ei '[c]rush|[f]rankenstein' | sed -n '1,120p'; echo '=== CANDIDATE PATHS ==='; find /home/ai-core-node -maxdepth 5 \( -type d -o -type f \) \( -iname '*crush*' -o -iname '*frankenstein*' \) 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,240p'; echo '=== GIT REPOS WITH CRUSH REMOTE/NAME ==='; find /home/ai-core-node -maxdepth 6 -type d -name .git 2>/dev/null | while read g; do r=${g%/.git}; u=$(git -C "$r" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || true); case "$r $u" in *[Cc][Rr][Uu][Ss][Hh]*) printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$r" "$(git -C "$r" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)" "$u";; esac; done | sed -n '1,120p'
